headline: Austria's Plansee Launches Takeover Bid for 23.4% of Chile's Molymet
summary: Austrian engineering company Plansee launched a tender offer (OPA) to acquire 23.36% of Chilean molybdenum processor Molymet at 11,400 pesos per share, representing a 5.53% market premium.
why: Molymet is the world's largest processor of molybdenum and rhenium, critical materials for superalloys and advanced metal products.

impacts.name: Molymet
impacts.why: Plansee offered 11,400 Chilean pesos per share, offering a 5.53% premium to buy 23.36% of the company.
